description: Meeting prep was produced without pulling the calendar invite for the Springline meeting, identifying the attendees, or researching them. The client-meeting-prep workflow explicitly requires attendee identification and research as a core step. Attendee context was completely absent from the output.
correction: Chase's client-meeting-prep workflow starts by pulling the calendar event from M365, extracting all attendees, then researching each one via LinkedIn, web search, and Clay before assembling the brief.
systemic_fix: Enforce workflow execution — Chase must run step-01 (meeting details + attendees) before any brief is assembled. No brief is complete without attendee research.
